holderQuote: Ishkr sighed. He was suddenly there, between the guests and the floating…droplets of water?
effectQuote: They whirled around him as he lifted one glowing paw.

holderQuote: Ishkr also got two forks and yanked a crossbow out from under one of the tables.
effectQuote: He cast a spell, and a gold coin lying on the floor floated up—and stuck to his paw!
